results.name: Nat.ModEq.mul_left
results.source_text:
protected theorem mul_left (c : ℕ) (h : a ≡ b [MOD n]) : c * a ≡ c * b [MOD n] :=
  (h.mul_left' _).of_dvd (dvd_mul_left _ _)

results.name: AddMonoidAlgebra.modOf
results.source_text:
/-- The remainder upon division by `of' k G g`. -/
noncomputable def modOf (x : k[G]) (g : G) : k[G] :=
  letI := Classical.decPred fun g₁ => ∃ g₂, g₁ = g + g₂
  .ofCoeff <| x.coeff.filter fun g₁ => ¬∃ g₂, g₁ = g + g₂
results.docstring: The remainder upon division by `of' k G g`.
